563:t_025:44.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノリコ$$... You've been fighting alongside them all this time.」

563:t_025:45.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes. They're my comrades, with the same mission and the same burning passion.」

563:t_025:46.en:
$n
(There are goodbyes, and there are new meetings... That's how the world keeps turning...)

563:t_027:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The distortion in the dimensional boundary is increasing rapidly!」

563:t_027:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「This is...! It's the same pattern as the $$時空震動$$ that occurred in $$第２新東京市$$!」

563:t_027:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Will we be thrown into the center of the galaxy again!?」

563:t_029:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I've confirmed the destruction of all the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

563:t_029:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Stay alert. Order all units to hold position until we're certain it's safe.」

563:t_030:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I've confirmed the destruction of all the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

563:t_030:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「But if this dimensional distortion becomes permanent...」

563:t_030:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It will speed up the $$宇宙怪獣$$' invasion of the solar system...」

563:t_031:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「But $$ランカ$$-chan and $$シェリル$$'s singing didn't reach them.」

563:t_031:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Don't give up after one or two tries! Next time, keep singing till it reaches their hearts!」

563:t_031:3.en:
$$キャシー$$
「That's what $$熱気バサラ$$ would say, anyway.」

563:t_031:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Well said, $$キャシー$$. It was like $$オズマ$$ possessed you.」

563:t_031:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'm sure $$ランカ・リー$$ and $$シェリル・ノーム$$ both understand that.」

563:t_031:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This ship will keep supporting their singing however we can.」

563:t_100:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$ニコラ$$'s impatience and frustration... I was the same when $$ブライト$$ nearly took me off the $$ガンダム$$ during the $$一年戦争$$...)

563:t_100:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I can laugh it off now, but back then, it felt like he'd rejected everything I was.)

563:t_100:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
(And in the end, I lost $$リュウ$$... I don't want him to face that same regret...)

563:t_101:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(If I could start over, what would I want to do...?)

563:t_101:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I'd return to my own world... Or go back even further, and $$綾波$$...)

563:t_102:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(If I could change the world however I wanted, what would I do...?)

563:t_102:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Would I go back before Dad died...? Back to when I was with $$スミス$$...? Back to when Coach was alive...?)

563:t_102:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(...I... want to see Big Sis... I don't want to start over. I want to see her here, in this moment...)

563:t_103:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Don't shed tears on the battlefield, even if they're tears of joy, $$タカヤ$$!」

563:t_103:2.en:
$$カズミ$$
「That's what he would say, $$ノリコ$$.」

563:t_103:4.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Let's both cry to our hearts' content. After we've beaten that enemy.」

563:t_103:6.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Each of us is a small fire, but when the two combine, we become a blazing flame!」

563:t_103:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$'s blazing flame is invincible! Watch us, Coach!!」

563:t_104:0.en:
$$アルト$$
(I believe you'll understand humans someday...!)

563:t_104:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(But right now... I have no choice but to fight! $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ are behind me!)

563:t_105:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
($$ニコラ$$... What... was I to you...?)

563:t_105:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
(I'm... no Princess... I'm not $$ノノ$$'s Big Sis... I... The real me...)

563:t_106:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
(My strong, kind, wonderful Big Sis... $$ノノ$$... doesn't know what to do...)

563:t_106:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(My strong, kind, wonderful Big Sis... $$ノノ$$... doesn't know what to do...)

563:t_106:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(My strong, kind, wonderful Big Sis... $$ノノ$$... doesn't know what to do...)

563:t_106:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
(At a time like this... What would you have done, $$ノノリリ$$...?)

563:t_106:7.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(At a time like this... What would you have done, $$ノノリリ$$...?)

563:t_106:8.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(At a time like this... What would you have done, $$ノノリリ$$...?)

563:t_107:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(Not one of these bastards understands how I feel...!)

563:t_107:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(To hell with it! If I'm going to lose my $$トップレス$$ powers anyway, I might as well go out in a blaze of glory like a hero!)

563:t_108:0.en:
$$チコ$$
(Oh, come on! What are Princess, $$ノノ$$, and $$ニコラ$$ doing!?)

563:t_108:1.en:
$$チコ$$
(At this rate, I'll have to give it my all and represent the $$トップレス$$ myself!)

563:t_108:2.en:
$$チコ$$
(...Well... They've all helped me so much. I guess it's not so bad to do this once in a while...!)

563:t_109:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「These weird enemies keep coming one after another. Even if they help pay off my debt, I'm sick of it...」

563:t_109:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(It makes me dream of a world without debt...)

563:t_109:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Or so I'd like to say, but I want no part of a world with no challenge. If I wished to start over...)
